goal: Reject HTTP requests specifying invalid or unsupported Transfer-Encoding headers with a 400 Bad Request
Prevent HTTP request framing ambiguities and desynchronization vulnerabilities on the RPC server
agreement: Questioned when this arises realistically given bitcoin-cli does not send these codings (winterrdog)

categories.name: rpc
why: P2 because it eliminates potential HTTP request desynchronization and framing ambiguity vulnerabilities
Enforces RFC 9112 compliance across all Transfer-Encoding headers received by the built-in HTTP server
